summary:
Fixed the deadlock in [TransferService.java](/app/app/TransferService.java) by locking accounts in deterministic account-id order instead of transfer direction order.

Also made the transfer counters `AtomicInteger`, since different account pairs can update them concurrently.

Verification: `./test.sh` passes, including the second verification run. Note that running the test also updated `classes/TransferService.class`.
